map.💡 公式：单位长度质量=流量×效率/速度；截面积 A=质量长度×1000/ρ；单: Formula: mass per length = feed rate times efficiency / speed; cross-section A = mass length times 1000 / rho; single-track width is about spot plus 0.0003 times P; single-track height = A / (0.74 times width); overlap step = width times (1 minus overlap ratio).

map.📚 深度解析：激光熔覆厚度计算（单道高/宽/搭接步距）: In-depth: Laser Cladding Thickness Calculation (single-track height / width / overlap step)
map.熔覆工艺开发：由送粉量、扫描速度与功率估算单道尺寸: Cladding process development: estimate single-track dimensions from powder amount, scan speed and power
map.多层多道规划：按搭接步距与单道高排布层数和道数: Multi-layer multi-track planning: arrange layers and tracks by overlap step and single-track height
map.效率评估：算沉积速率与比能，衡量粉末利用率: Efficiency evaluation: compute deposition rate and specific energy to assess powder utilization
map.算法：单位长度沉积量 = 粉末流量×熔覆效率/100/扫描速度（g/mm）；截面: Algorithm: mass deposited per unit length = powder feed rate times cladding efficiency / 100 / scan speed (g/mm); cross-section A = mass per unit length times 1000 / density (mm2); single-track width = spot diameter plus 0.0003 times power (mm), and not less than 0.8 times the spot diameter; single-track height = A / (0.74 times single-track width); overlap step = single-track width times (1 minus overlap ratio / 100); deposition rate = feed rate times efficiency / 100 (g/min); specific energy = power / feed rate (W min / g). Note the scan speed unit is mm/min.
map.例：流量 10g/min、效率 85%、扫描速度 600mm/min、功率 20: Example: feed rate 10 g/min, efficiency 85%, scan speed 600 mm/min, power 2000 W, spot 3 mm, density 7.85 g/cm3, overlap 30% gives unit length deposit 0.01417 g/mm, cross-section 1.805 mm2, single-track width 3.6 mm, single-track height 0.677 mm, overlap step 2.52 mm, layers per mm 1.476, deposition rate 8.5 g/min, specific energy 200 W min/g. If the scan speed is mistakenly entered as 8 mm/min, the single-track height would be computed as 76.21 mm under the same parameters, which is physically impossible; the unit should be checked.
map.按单道横截面近似为弓形（约占外接矩形面积的 74%）折算高度；实际截面形状随功率: It converts the single-track cross-section approximated as a circular segment (about 74% of the circumscribed rectangle area) into height; the actual cross-section shape varies with power, powder feeding and molten pool flow; the precise value should be determined by metallographic measurement.
map.搭接率取多少合适？: What is a suitable overlap ratio?
map.常用 30%~50%。搭接过小道间出现凹陷，过大则热积累导致稀释率上升与变形；高: Commonly 30% to 50%. Too small an overlap leaves dents between tracks; too large increases heat accumulation, raising dilution rate and deformation; for hard and crack-prone materials a larger value is preferred with inter-layer temperature control.
